StabilizedLinearSR3 optimizer

These notebooks demonstrate use cases for the StabilizedLinearSR3 optimizer. The primary requirement for these notebooks is pysindy 1.7.5/numpy<2.0, but the requirements file includes a pinned version of a known-good run on python 3.10.12. The notebooks are not likely to be kept up to date across major version bumps.

  • Example 7 Jupyter notebook – now with stable linear models of arbitrary order!
  • In this notebook we address state space models for a plasma physics experiment
